newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Mills bid for high protein.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Mills bid for high protein.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat cash bids were mostly lower on Wednesday, pressured by a drop in MGE futures, but dealers continued to note strong mill demand for high protein wheat.
"We saw some interest in the higher protein for domestic flour business," a Montana dealer said.
Farmer selling continued to be slow as producers opted to store the grain in hopes of higher prices, dealers said.
"We're done seeing their winter wheat," a dealer said. "It's all put away. If we put 50 to 75 cents a bushel back in (to prices), I think we'll see some grain trade."
In North Dakota, producers were focusing on corn and soybean harvest in anticipation of weather-related harvest delays, a dealer said.
Forecasts there called for rain, possibly mixed with snow on Thursday. Farmer selling of corn and soybeans was said to be steady with "trucks lining up" at grain elevators.
